name: Pre-Orders for WooCommerce – PreCart
author: tasin07

sections.description:
Take control of product launches with Pre-Orders for WooCommerce – PreCart, the ultimate solution for managing pre-orders, building customer anticipation, and maximizing early sales. Perfect for limited editions, crowdfunded products, or upcoming releases!

What is the difference between preorder and regular order?

The main difference between a preorder and a regular order is when you place the order and when the item is available for shipping or pickup:
– Pre-Order: You are ordering an item before it is officially released or available in stock. Payment may be charged immediately or when the item ships. It guarantees that you will get the item once it’s released.
– Regular Order: You are buying an item that is already available and in stock. It is processed and shipped (or available for pickup) immediately or within the standard timeframe.

Pre-Orders are common for things like video games, smartphones,Book launches,Music/album releases,Crowdfunded products, limited-edition products & many more niches. Companies use them to gauge demand and secure early sales.

Why Stores Love Pre-Orders

🚀 Launch with Confidence: Test demand and secure revenue before manufacturing or restocking.
⏱️ Create Scarcity: Use pre-order limits (“Only 100 available!”) to drive urgency.
📈 Boost Cash Flow: Collect payments upfront to fund production or inventory.
📣 Build Anticipation: Share pre-order milestones on social media (“500+ pre-ordered!”).

Key Features of Pre-Order

  • Enable pre-orders for individual products or product variations.
  • Set pre-order availability dates and deadlines.
  • Display pre-order badge and release date on product pages.
  • Manage pre-order limits and inventory allocation.
  • Compatible with all WooCommerce payment gateways.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the precart folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to **PreCart > Settings ** to configure the plugin.
  4. Enable pre-orders for individual products from the product edit page.
sections.faq:
How do I enable pre-orders for a product?

Navigate to your product edit screen, enable the “Pre-Order” checkbox in the Product Data section, and set your dates for each product. if you want to enable preorder for all products you can do it from PreCart > settings

Can I collect payments for pre-orders immediately?

Yes, you can collect payments for pre-orders immediately , we will add ‘pay later’ option in the pro version soon.

Does this work with my theme/other plugins?

Compatible with all WooCommerce-supported themes and most payment gateways.

How are pre-orders tracked in inventory?

Pre-orders deduct from a separate stock pool to avoid overselling.
